info.title: Kestrova
info.description: Kestrova Solidity security scanner for AI coding agents: smart contract static analysis (Slither) with a pre-audit security report. Send {"sources": {"File.sol": "<source>"}}; get every finding with detector, severity, confidence and line locations for 0.25 USDC (POST /scan/findings), or add a plain-English explanation and fix per finding plus PDF/SARIF for 1 USDC (POST /scan), on Solana or Base (x402). Free preview at POST /preview and the remote MCP server at /mcp (scan_solidity_preview). No local solc needed. Automated analysis, not an audit: zero findings does not mean a contract is safe.
info.x-guidance: Solidity vulnerability detection (Slither). Call POST /preview first: free, no key, returns severity counts, High/Medium detector names and one representative finding. Paid and optional, via x402 on Base or Solana (terms in the 402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header): POST /scan/findings (0.25 USDC) returns every finding with file and line; POST /scan (1 USDC) adds a plain-English explanation and fix per finding and PDF/SARIF files. Pay only with your user's explicit approval and within their spending limit; charged only after a successful scan. MCP: /mcp (scan_solidity_preview, scan_solidity_findings, scan_solidity_full, payment_terms). Automated analysis, not an audit: zero findings does not mean a contract is safe.

post.summary: Fetch paid Solidity scan result again via wallet signature
post.description: Free; never a payment. Use after an unclear paid outcome (202/409 pending, timeout, lost response) instead of paying again. Step 1: POST {"payment": "<the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value you sent>", "wallet": "<paying address>", "action": "challenge"} returns {"message", "token", "expires"} (valid 120 s). Step 2: sign the exact message string (UTF-8 bytes) with the paying wallet: Solana = ed25519 message signature, base64; Base = EIP-191 personal_sign, 0x hex. This is a message signature, not a transaction. Step 3: POST {"payment", "wallet", "message", "token", "expires", "signature"} returns the original result (same tier as paid). 202 = settlement not confirmed yet: retry later, do not pay again; 404 = no settled payment for this key.

payment.description: The PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value of the original paid request

wallet.description: The paying wallet address (Solana base58 or Base 0x address)

message.description: Step 3: the message returned in step 1, unchanged

token.description: Step 3: the token returned in step 1

expires.description: Step 3: the expires value returned in step 1

signature.description: Step 3: Solana base64 ed25519 signature, or Base 0x hex personal_sign

200.description: Step 1: the challenge; step 3: the original paid result

202.description: Settlement not confirmed yet: retry recovery later; do not pay again

401.description: Expired or invalid challenge or signature

404.description: No settled payment for this key

429.description: Too many recovery attempts; retry after the Retry-After header
